name: Petalpuff the White Cat
blurb: Petalpuff, a round-faced white kitten with a thick, ruffled coat as crisp as fresh carnations, sits among pink and lavender blooms and purrs.

name: Posy the Basket Cat
blurb: Posy, a small snow-white cat with green eyes and a pink nose, naps curled in a woven handled basket lined with pink and purple garden blooms.

name: Lilac the Doorstep Cat
blurb: Lilac, a cream-white cat with soft lilac-grey ears, mask, paws and tail, waits on the garden doorstep to sniff each new bouquet that arrives.
